knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Appendix A: a volume equal to the waterslide pool has to be filtered no less often than hourly.
Appendix A (General): if inspection finds a faulty or damaged flume, close the waterslide until repairs are done.
Appendix A (Management): an observer at the head of each flume and one at the receiving pool are the minimum staff.

practicalCriteria: In a supplied waterslide scenario, confirms observer positions and the clear-flume signal before a rider starts.
Carries out a full flume inspection on a supplied flume and records the result, closing the slide for a supplied fault.
Checks the bather warning signs at the entry and the flume and states what is missing, if anything.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of the clear-flume signal
stopWorkCriteria: Faulty or damaged flume found: close the waterslide and report.
Top observer cannot see the full flume and no clear-flume device works: do not start riders.
Warning signs missing at the entry or flume: do not open until replaced.
